name: Shielding Elixir
description: This is a complicated potion, requiring a potent berries skin and seeds, mixed with the juices of sitrus and leppa. The complication comes from how each type of berry requires its own tempature.
effect: Reduce the damage from a Specific Type of attack by 8; this applies before defenses. The typing matches the berry used in its brewing. This Elixir can be drank by the User as a reaction as long as they have their Bonus Action. Cooldown of 3 Turns.
recipes: 500 Poke, 1 Rare Damage Reduction Berry, 2 Sitrus Berries, 1 Leppa Berry.
